query:
SELECT 
  pr.id,
  pr.requestNumber,
  pr.urgencyLevel,
  pr.status,
  pr.directorApprovals,
  pr.updatedAt
FROM purchaseRequests pr
WHERE pr.urgencyLevel IN ('urgente', 'emergencial')
  AND pr.status NOT IN ('concluida', 'cancelada', 'rejeitada')
ORDER BY pr.updatedAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
